blockingContradictions.detail: INV-04 allows at most 4 reconciliation read(s) in 60 s (under total network failure), but SM-SAVE T-S31 (UnknownOutcome x CheckAgain, guard 'automatic reads spent') emits a reconciliation read on every repetition, and no guard on it limits repetition or references a clock.
blockingContradictions.ownerAction: decide which governs: bound T-S31 (a clock, a count or a rate in its guard) or amend INV-04

missingDecisions.detail: SM-SAVE (UnknownOutcome, ReconcileReadFailed) is specified only when 'fewer than three automatic reads made'; no transition covers the counter at its limit, so that input fails closed without a stated outcome.

missingInterfaces.detail: The catalog carries all 134 commands (StartInvestigation, RenameInvestigation, ActivateInvestigation, MarkAwaitingEvidence, ...) inside CommandEnvelope, but `CommandEnvelope = { CommandId: Guid; Investigation: InvestigationId; ExpectedVersion: AggregateVersion option }` holds only identities and versions: no field can say which command it is or carry its body. IF41-DOMAIN.Decide must distinguish them from that value alone.
missingInterfaces.ownerAction: add the command (a union of the catalog commands, with payloads) to CommandEnvelope, or name the out-of-band source consumers must read it from
